reasoning: The claim is misleading because it misrepresents the findings of the widely cited March 2023 Goldman Sachs economic report. The report estimated that generative AI could expose the equivalent of roughly 300 million full-time jobs worldwide to automation, not that 300 million jobs will definitely be replaced or eliminated. Furthermore, the report emphasized that for the majority of occupations, generative AI would complement rather than fully substitute human labor, while also creating new roles and boosting global economic productivity. Framing this projection as a definitive statement that 300 million jobs "will be replaced" oversimplifies and exaggerates the research.
